refs.title: Perca enana de Fridman (Pseudochromis fridmani) (Commons file; see the page)
refs.author: see Commons file page
refs.note: Working copy mirrored left-right (the fish faces left) and rotated 22.4 deg clockwise about the peduncle centre (the fish is pitched nose-up). All px are in that levelled 1920x1280 copy. By-eye annotation, about +-12 px (1% of length). The colour is saturated beyond the true magenta-purple (photo is blown), so colour comes from the previous plan; the dorsal base is placed 22 px inside the fin edge; pectoral fin hidden, not drawn.

frame.note: px -> card: u = (x - xTail)/W, v = (y - yAxis)/W, W = xSnout - xTail (total length).

thickness.note: No front or top photo and no cited figure; the existing 0.5 is kept, 3D front and top views are NOT claimed validated.

look.note: Colours carried from the previous plan (the photo is colour-blown). Fin colour: grid file (mean photo colours).

barPaths.note: the black stripe from the snout through the eye
